newsitem.title: POLAND: ComputerLand sees group net PLN 19.6 mln. [CORRECTED 09:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: ComputerLand sees group net PLN 19.6 mln. [CORRECTED 09:55 GMT]

text.p: Polish software firm ComputerLand SA expects to raise its group net profit to 19.6 million zlotys this year from 11.8 million in 1996, the firm said in an abbreviated version of an issue prospectus.
The prospectus, for stock-option issues to management and employees, said the group would boost group sales to 321.6 million zlotys this year from 183.5 million zlotys in 1996.
The prospect reiterated the parent firm's previous 1997 net forecast of 15.2 million zlotys on 225 million sales.
The parent firm made a net profit of 11.2 million zlotys in 1996 (corrects from 1997) on 173.3-million sales.
